text_en: Jotham was twenty-five years old when he began to reign; he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Jerushah daughter of Zadok.
text_cn: 约堂登极时年二十五岁，在耶路撒冷作王凡十六年；他的母亲名叫耶鲁沙，是匝克多的女儿。

text_en: He did what was right in the sight of the Lord just as his father Uzziah had done—only he did not invade the temple of the Lord . But the people still followed corrupt practices.
text_cn: 约堂行了上主视为正义的事，完全像他父亲所作的一样，只是没有进入上主的圣所；但百姓仍然败坏。

text_en: He built the upper gate of the house of the Lord , and did extensive building on the wall of Ophel.
text_cn: 他建筑了上主殿宇的上门，在敖斐耳城墙上，也作了许多工程，

text_en: Moreover he built cities in the hill country of Judah, and forts and towers on the wooded hills.
text_cn: 在犹大山地建筑了一些城池，在丛林中也建了一些营寨和堡垒。

text_en: He fought with the king of the Ammonites and prevailed against them. The Ammonites gave him that year one hundred talents of silver, ten thousand cors of wheat and ten thousand of barley. The Ammonites paid him the same amount in the second and the third years.
text_cn: 约堂与阿孟子民的君王交战，战胜了他们，因此阿孟子民那一年给他进贡：银子一百“塔冷通”，小麦一万“苛尔”，大麦一万“苛尔”。以后第二第三年，阿孟子民仍进了这些贡物。

text_en: So Jotham became strong because he ordered his ways before the Lord his God.
text_cn: 约堂因为在上主他的天主前，时常履行正道，所以日渐强盛。

text_en: Now the rest of the acts of Jotham, and all his wars and his ways, are written in the Book of the Kings of Israel and Judah.
text_cn: 约堂其余的事迹，以及他的战绩和作为，都记载在《以色列和犹大列王实录》上。

text_en: He was twenty-five years old when he began to reign; he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem.
text_cn: 他即位时年二十五岁，在耶路撒冷作王十六年。

text_en: Jotham slept with his ancestors, and they buried him in the city of David; and his son Ahaz succeeded him.
text_cn: 约堂与祖先同眠，葬在达味城；他的儿子阿哈次继位为王。
